# Auto-generated schematic symbols
import sys
import os

# Get project path and import kicad schematic interface
PROJECT_PATH = os.environ['PROJECT_PATH']
sys.path.append(PROJECT_PATH)
from modules.kicad_sch_interface import *

# Define center position for the main component (NE555D)
center_x_1, center_y_1 = 150.0, 110.0

# Place the NE555D (U1) at the center
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Timer",
    symbol_name="NE555D",
    pos_x=center_x_1,
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="U1",
    value="NE555D",
    rotation=0,
    mirror=None
)

# Place the LED (D1) to the right of the NE555D
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Device",
    symbol_name="LED",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + 30.0,   # 30 mm to the right
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="D1",
    value="LED",
    rotation=0,
    mirror=None
)

# Connect U1 VCC (pin 8) to D1 anode (pin A)
connect_pins("U1", "VCC", "D1", "A")

# Connect U1 GND (pin 1) to D1 cathode (pin K)
connect_pins("U1", "GND", "D1", "K")

# Connect U1 OUT (pin 3, named Q) to D1 anode (pin A)
connect_pins("U1", "Q", "D1", "A")

# Write out all wires
write_out_all_wires()
